Aisha (People Ops): Hey team — quick q from a new hire who's returning from leave part-time (3 days/week). They asked about the parental stipend/prorating and how to record time in Workday.
Rob (Engineering): Thanks — is this a formal reduced schedule (FLSA toggle) or an informal arrangement?
Aisha (People Ops): Formal agreed schedule in their return plan — 60% FTE for 8 weeks then reassess. Manager approved.
Sanjay (Payroll): For stipends we prorate by payroll days active. We need FTE change effective date in Workday before payroll cutoff. Also note tax withholdings apply. :money_with_wings:
Lena (Benefits): We keep medical/401k active if they remain on payroll. Parental stipend gets pro-rated; benefits add-ons (backup care) follow policy dates. Will need signed reduced-schedule Acknowledgement.
Maya (People Ops): Filing checklist I give employees: signed ack, updated Workday job change (PT effective date), copy to benefits@, and schedule for check-ins.
Aisha (People Ops): Is there a specific Workday time off code for partial parental leave? Manager asked what to choose for their calendar/TO.
HR Bot: Parental leave codes:
```
PARENTAL_LEAVE_FULL - full parental leave
PARENTAL_LEAVE_PT - partial/graded parental leave
FLEX_RETURN - flexible return scheduling (use with PT)
```
Use PARENTAL_LEAVE_PT for reduced schedule. Save doc: https://redwood-internal/hr/parental-proration
Sanjay (Payroll): Confirmed. Steps:
1) Manager submits job change with new FTE in Workday.
2) Employee signs ack and uploads to DocuSign folder.
3) Benefits update done same day.
We can run a sample payroll calc if you DM me the employee ID.
Rob (Engineering): Oncall coverage — we'll rotate tills their ramp. I'll put in an interim oncall buddy and update rota.
Aisha (People Ops): Great. Can someone draft the short email to send the employee with next steps and links?
Maya (People Ops): I'll draft and post here in 10m.
Lena (Benefits): One more — if they use intermittent LOA later, FMLA eligibility still counts from original start date. Affirming with legal.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all — moving to action. :white_check_mark:
